## Configuration in MegaLinter

- Enable gawk by adding `AWK_GAWK` in [ENABLE_LINTERS variable](https://megalinter.io/beta/configuration/#activation-and-deactivation)
- Disable gawk by adding `AWK_GAWK` in [DISABLE_LINTERS variable](https://megalinter.io/beta/configuration/#activation-and-deactivation)

| Variable | Description | Default value |
| ----------------- | -------------- | -------------- |
| AWK_GAWK_ARGUMENTS | User custom arguments to add in linter CLI call<br/>Ex: `-s --foo "bar"` |  |
| AWK_GAWK_COMMAND_REMOVE_ARGUMENTS | User custom arguments to remove from command line before calling the linter<br/>Ex: `-s --foo "bar"` |  |
| AWK_GAWK_FILTER_REGEX_INCLUDE | Custom regex including filter<br/>Ex: `(src\|lib)` | Exclude no file |
| AWK_GAWK_FILTER_REGEX_EXCLUDE | Custom regex excluding filter<br/>Ex: `(test\|examples)` | Exclude no file |
| AWK_GAWK_CLI_LINT_MODE | Override default CLI lint mode<br/>- `file`: Calls the linter for each file | `file` |
| AWK_GAWK_FILE_EXTENSIONS | Allowed file extensions. `"*"` matches any extension, `""` matches empty extension. Empty list excludes all files<br/>Ex: `[".py", ""]` | `[".awk"]` |
| AWK_GAWK_FILE_NAMES_REGEX | File name regex filters. Regular expression list for filtering files by their base names using regex full match. Empty list includes all files<br/>Ex: `["Dockerfile(-.+)?", "Jenkinsfile"]` | Include every file |
| AWK_GAWK_PRE_COMMANDS | List of bash commands to run before the linter| None |
| AWK_GAWK_POST_COMMANDS | List of bash commands to run after the linter| None |
| AWK_GAWK_UNSECURED_ENV_VARIABLES  | List of env variables explicitly not filtered before calling AWK_GAWK and its pre/post commands| None |
| AWK_GAWK_DISABLE_ERRORS | Run linter but consider errors as warnings | `false` |
| AWK_GAWK_DISABLE_ERRORS_IF_LESS_THAN | Maximum number of errors allowed | `0` |
| AWK_GAWK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS | Maximum duration in seconds of the linter run, after which the linter process and its child processes are killed and reported as an error (exit code 124). Overrides LINTER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS. 0 disables the timeout | `300` |
| AWK_GAWK_CLI_EXECUTABLE | Override CLI executable | `['bash']` |

## Use this plugin

Add the descriptor URL of the plugin to `PLUGINS` in `.mega-linter.yml`. MegaLinter installs the plugin when it starts, whatever the flavor:

```yaml
PLUGINS:
  - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wesley-dean/mega-linter-plugin-gawk/refs/heads/main/mega-linter-plugin-gawk/gawk.megalinter-descriptor.yml
```

## Behind the scenes

### How are identified applicable files

- File extensions: `.awk`

<!-- markdownlint-disable -->
<!-- /* cSpell:disable */ -->
### How the linting is performed

- gawk is called one time by identified file (`file` CLI lint mode)

### Example calls

```shell
gawk --sandbox --lint -f script.awk </dev/null
```

```shell
gawk --sandbox --lint=fatal -f script.awk </dev/null
```


### Installation in Docker

MegaLinter runs these commands when it loads the plugin (only `RUN` instructions):

```dockerfile
RUN apk add --no-cache 'gawk=~5' && gawk --version | grep -Eq '^GNU Awk 5\.'
```

### Installation without Docker (native mode)

> **Native mode does not run plugins yet**: this section shows what the plugin declares for native mode.

Not available: see the MegaLinter checks of the plugin.

## MegaLinter checks

These results last changed on 2026-11-28, and MegaLinter checks the plugins every day. The checks only look at the descriptor of the plugin: they do not review the plugin, nor the tool it runs.

| Check | Result |
| :---- | :----- |
| Descriptor | ⚠️ Incomplete |
| Native mode | ❌ Not supported |
| SARIF output | ❌ |
| Native lock | ⚠️ No lock shipped by the plugin author |

### Required

Missing required items:

- **`native_install` declared and valid for the 5 native platforms** (`AWK_GAWK`): Native mode (MegaLinter without Docker) can not install the linter. Declare `native_install`, listing each of linux/amd64, linux/arm64, darwin/amd64, darwin/arm64 and windows/amd64 in `platforms` or in `unsupported` (with a reason)
- **SARIF output** (`AWK_GAWK`): The findings are missing from SARIF reports (GitHub code scanning, SARIF viewers, coding agents). Set `can_output_sarif: true` with `cli_sarif_args` when the tool outputs SARIF, otherwise `sarif_text_regex` (one finding per line of text) or `sarif_unified_diff: true` (formatters printing a diff)

### Recommended

Missing recommended items:

- **Native lock shipped next to the descriptor (`<name>.megalinter-native-lock.json`), for verified native installs**
- **Inline disable documentation URL (`linter_rules_inline_disable_url`)** (`AWK_GAWK`)
- **Ignore file documentation URL (`linter_rules_ignore_config_url`)** (`AWK_GAWK`)
- **SPDX license (`linter_spdx_license`)** (`AWK_GAWK`)
- **Speed (`linter_speed`, 1 to 5)** (`AWK_GAWK`)
- **Icon (`linter_icon_png_url`)** (`AWK_GAWK`)
- **IDE extensions (`ide`)** (`AWK_GAWK`)
- **Default configuration file (`config_file_name`)** (`AWK_GAWK`)
- **Test fixtures (`test_folder`)** (`AWK_GAWK`)

### Plugin authors

The requirements and how to fix them are described in [Create your own plugin](../plugins.md#create-your-own-plugin).
